messages.content: The hotel just emailed that our room is now an open studio instead of a one-bedroom suite. Before I agree to anything, confirm the actual beds in both rooms and give me the complete five-night totals after their discount or upgrade.

I checked the two layouts. The replacement studio has two queen beds in one open room and no sofa bed. The one-bedroom suite has two queen beds behind a bedroom door plus a queen sleeper sofa in the living area. Both allow three guests, and neither option changes the included breakfast, evening reception, or parking.
So our daughter still has her own queen in the studio, but we lose the door and the second sitting area. Is that right?

Correct. The studio preserves the two guaranteed queen beds, but everyone sleeps in the same room and there is no separate place to sit after bedtime. The suite adds privacy and a living room; the sleeper sofa is available but is not needed for occupancy.
Now break down the money against the $1,238 reservation. I want totals, not just the nightly change.

Keeping the studio reduces the five-night room charge by $125. The revised all-in hotel total is $1,113, including taxes, fees, and $90 parking. Restoring the one-bedroom suite adds $45 per night plus $36 in additional tax, making the all-in total $1,499. The suite is therefore $386 more than the discounted studio.

That is more than the separate-room difference I already rejected. Keep the studio at $1,113, but make sure the reservation still says two queens and three guests. Do not let them substitute a king studio.
I’ll accept the studio only with two queen beds guaranteed for three guests and have the revised total documented. The cancellation deadline remains 6:00 p.m. St. Louis time on March 15.
Go ahead and modify it, and confirm whether the reservation number changes.

The reservation has been modified under the existing confirmation STL-DRY-58341. It now guarantees an open studio with two queen beds for three guests; a king-room substitution is not permitted. The complete five-night total is $1,113.00, including taxes, fees, and $90.00 parking, with breakfast and the evening reception unchanged. Payment remains due at checkout, and free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. St. Louis time on March 15. With $175 estimated fuel and $50 for Fox and downtown parking, the revised trip base is $1,338.00 before other meals and activities.
